name: Masterful Command
body:
With a simple command, you can aid an ally.

Prerequisites: Leadership, Legendary Leader, Leadership score 10+

Benefit: You may use the aid another action up to 30 feet away so long as the recipient of the action can see and hear you. If you are aiding your cohort or one of your followers, the bonus provided by the aid another action is increased by +1.
